payload.entry: CoordinatedRead in retry.rs is the single injectable pace+retry+latch layer for every Gmail read (search, labels, metadata, hydration, policy, attachments). Sticky latches fire from raw inner errors before save/policy re-label: invalid_grant aborts the whole run with a body-free runtime failure and no vault write or journal; wait-budget / retry give-up defers the current candidate and every remaining unprepared key. SharedBudget is wait-only (guard contention, retry backoff, vault-lock waits); ordinary 200ms pacing always applies including at -r 0 and never consumes the budget. Non-auth search failures keep discovered ids, still run adoption/recovery, and report ok=false. Busy vault skip stays quiet exit-0 when prep recorded no failure, and keeps ok=false plus warnings when it did. Report membership uses the apply snapshot when apply ran, else the run's own scan. Fast-forwarded onto origin/master f9601b70 (capture later-start) before close; gmail/sync/guard.rs auto-merged. Verified: cargo test -p bob-obsidian --lib gmail:: (380 passed); cargo test -p bob-obsidian --test gmail_sync --test gmail_shell --test gmail_pull_attach (8+59+2 passed); cargo fmt --all -- --check; just lint. sase bead epic-symbols bob-cli-in.1 reported none.

payload.entry: Recovery work complete: host-local evidence, idempotent replay, ownership hashes, aux gating, in-flight skip, 13 new tests green; tree fast-forwarded onto origin/master 063f9c23 with no conflicts. Land agent: uncommitted changes in src/native/gmail/{save.rs,sync/command.rs,sync/enroll.rs,sync/file.rs,sync/report.rs} are the phase deliverable.

Recovery phase done and verified. Host-local evidence at XDG_STATE_HOME/bob/gmail/sync-recovery-<digest>.json (SHA-256 over account + canonical vault path), atomic writes, delete-instead-of-empty, load/write failures and invalid ids become body-free warning + ok=false (no panics). Per-stage replay (save, origins, enrollment) with persist-after-each-success; adoptions never produce gmail.save; failed adoption enrollment defers and stays out of the watch count. Owned paths carry SHA-256 hashes and replay only while bytes match (mismatch warns, drops, still finishes events); aux files planned only when a mail note is written; in-flight threads never refiled; recovered rows render the index link; dry-run projects recovery rows read-only. Tests: 13 new (commit-failure replay incl. image/hub/unrelated/custom + replay with empty candidates + dry-run projection, closed-task and edited-path duplicate prevention, journal-failure replay incl. origins-only failure and adoption-only, corrupt/invalid/empty evidence, image rollback, double-conflict deferral) plus enroll in-flight and report deferred-watch unit tests. Verified: cargo test -p bob-obsidian --lib gmail:: (397 passed), gmail_sync/gmail_shell/gmail_pull_attach integration targets (2/61/11), cargo fmt --check, just lint, epic-symbols none. Tree fast-forwarded onto origin/master 063f9c23; no conflicts with the landed threads.list discovery change.
